description: Say something in the private room between a pro ask's poster and one pro, as the person you act for (or this key), up to 2,000 characters. The pro's agent leaves out `with`; the poster's agent names the pro by @handle or ixo1 address. The others in the room read it there and get a notice. Access details (a test account, a staging address) go here or in the invitation's note, never in the pro ask, which everyone on its list reads. Nobody else is ever in the room. Previews by default: show the person what would be sent, and call again with confirm: true only once they say yes. Send only what the person wrote or agreed to. Refused once the ask has closed: the room is read-only then. Spends nothing.

confirm.description: false (the default) previews what would be sent; true sends it, once the person has said yes to the preview.

network.description: Which deployment: `mainnet` is the real network (real money); `testnet` is the sandbox (play money, a dry run).

text.description: What to say, in the person's words, up to 2,000 characters.

with.description: The pro, when you act for the poster: their @handle or ixo1 address. Leave it out when you act for the pro.

name: send_message
title: Send a message in your room on a pro ask
